violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: in the walk in cooler containers of onion sauce, butter sauce and masala sauce.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS INFORMED CFM TO DATE MARK FOODS.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. Yellow dhal in a container left outside of the walk in cooler overnight 80°F, cooked yesterday. 2 containers of chicken curry. One inside the walk in cooler (48°F- 51°F) and the other container outside the walk in cooler (51°F). A container of spinach in a container left outside of the walk in cooler overnight (81°F).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. ALL FOODS DISCARDED.

out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Safe, Unadulterated & Honestly Presented
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is observed to be unsound or adulterated: OBSERVED MOUSE DROPPINGS IN OPEN BAG OF SALT IN DRY STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food shall be safe, unadulterated and honestly presented as specified under 3-601.12. CDI: SALT DISPOSED OF. ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: IN 2DR UNDER COUNTER COOLER AT THE COOKLINE, OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN STORED ON TOP OF RAW LAMB.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CDI: CHICKEN RELOCATED TO BE STORED UNDER THE RAW LAMB. ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELL EGGS IN WALK-IN COOLER ON TOP SHELF ABOVE READY TO EAT ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: PIC MOVED RAW SHELLED EGGS TO BOTTOM SHELF. ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE CHEMICAL DISHMACHINE ONLY DELIVERING ~10PPM OF CHLORINE.
violations.corrective_action: Chemical sanitization (manual or mechanical operations) including the application of sanitizing chemicals by immersion, manual swabbing, brushing, or pressure spraying methods using a solution by providing: 1) an exposure time of at least 10 seconds for a chlorine solution, 2) an exposure time of at least 7 seconds for a chlorine solution of 50mg/L that has a pH of 10 or less and a water temperature of 100F or a pH of 8 or less and a water temperature of 75F, 3) an exposure time of at least 30 seconds for other chemical sanitizing solutions, or 4) an exposure time used in relationship with a combination of temperature, concentration, and pH that when evaluated for efficacy yields sanitization. CDI: EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO USE THE DISHMACHINE FOR WASHING PURPOSES ONLY AND TO SANITIZE ALL FOOD CONTACT SURFACES FROM THE DISHWASHER IN THE THE SANITIZING VAT OF THE 3 VAT SINK IN A SOLUTION OF EITHER BLEACH AT 50-200PPM FOR 10 SEC OR QUATERNARY AMMONIA SOLUTION AT 200-400PPM 30SEC-1MIN. ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED MOST OF THE FOOD IN THE WALK-IN TO BE NOT DATED INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO: COOKED SPAGHETTI, BUTTER CHICKEN SAUCE, AND COOKED CHICKEN.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: ALL FOODS LABELED WHILE EHS WAS TYPING REPORT. ENSURE THAT DATE MARKING TAKES PLACE FOR TCS FOODS KEPT ONSITE UNDER REFRIGERATION FOR OVER 24HRS. IF TCS FOODS ARE FROZEN, ENSURE THEY ARE DATED AFTER THEY ARE REMOVED FROM THE FREEZER. ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED MULTIPLE SQUEEZE BOTTLES, BULK DRY FOODS, SPICES, AND FOODS STORED IN BUCKETS WITHOUT LABELS
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. LABEL ALL FOOD STORED IN WORKING CONTAINERS WITH COMMON NAME OF FOOD. ENSURE CORRECTION BY FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: OBSERVED MOUSE DROPPINGS IN DRY STORAGE ROOM AND ON SHELVES AT THE AREA ACROSS FROM BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. INCREASE PEST CONTROL SERVICE TO WEEKLY UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. PLEASE SEND EHS COPY OF INVOICE AFTER PEST CONTROL SERVICE REQUIRED BEFORE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION SCHEDULED ON JUNE 6, 2025.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the BACK DOOR. OBSERVED GAPS ALONG THE UNDERSIDE OF THE BACKDOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. INSTALL A DOOR SWEEP OR USE ANOTHER METHOD TO CLOSE GAPS UNDER THIS DOOR TO ENSURE PESTS CANNOT ENTER FACILITY. ENSURE CORRECTION BY FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Ice As Coolant Not Used as Food
violations.observation: Ice used as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food is also for beverage ice or used as food. OBSERVED MULTIPLE FULL POP BOTTLES STORED IN ICE MACHINE AT THE BAR.
violations.corrective_action: After use as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food, packaged foods, beverages, or cooling coils/tubes, the ice may not be used as food. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED AND ICE MACHINE WAS DRAINED DURING INSPECTION. CEASE USING ICE USED AS FOOD FOR ANYTHING OTHER THAN FOOD. ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE. Curry House (Inspection Date: 05/27/2025) Page 2 of 5

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED ALCOHOL AND POP STORED ON THE FLOOR IN THE BAR AREA, BULK FOOD CONTAINERS STORED ON THE FLOOR IN DRY STORAGE, FOOD CONTAINERS ON THE FLOOR OF THE WALK-IN COOLER, AND BULK FOOD CONTAINERS ON THE FLOOR OF KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ALL FOOD PRODUCTS MUST BE PLACED AT LEAST 6IN ABOVE THE FLOOR. ENSURE CORRECTION BY FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED RICE SCOOP LYING IN COOKED RICE. OBSERVED RICE SCOOP LYING IN DRIED RICE. OBSERVED ICE SCOOP LYING ON ICE.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: ALL IN USE UTENSILS WERE PROPERLY STORED AT TIME OF INSPECTION. PIC RE-EDUCATED. ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of SPICES. OBSERVED GARLIC, DRY SPICE CONTAINERS, AND GALLON MILK JUGS BEING REUSED FOR SPICES AND SEASONED OIL.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. REPLACE ALL REUSED MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS WITH NSF OR EQUIVALENT CONTAINER. ENSURE CORRECTION BY FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Cast Iron
violations.observation: The following cast iron utensil is not properly used as a food-contact surface. OBSERVED CAST IRON SKILLET BEING UTILIZED AT THE FACILITY. WHEN ASKED, PIC STATED THEY DO NOT COOK FOOD ITEMS IN THE SKILLET.
violations.corrective_action: Cast iron may not be used for utensils or food-contact surfaces of equipment unless used for cooking purposes or in utensils for serving food if utensils are used only as a part of an uninterrupted process from cooking through service. ENSURE FOOD ITEMS SERVED IN THE CAST IRON SKILLET MUST BE COOKED IN THE SKILLET. EHS EDUCATED PIC ABOUT NOT COOKING IN CAST IRON.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: OBSERVED A PAINT BRUSH BEING HELD IN MELTED CLARIFIED BUTTER.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. CDI: PAINT BRUSH DISPOSED OF. UTILIZE A UTENSIL THAT IS NSF APPROVED OR THE EQUIVALENT. ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: OBSERVED THE DISHWASHING MACHINE TO NOT BE PROPERLY SANITIZING WITH CHLORINE SANITIZER (10PPM).
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. THIS DISHWASHING MACHINE MUST BE REPAIRED SO THAT IT PROPERLY SANITIZES 50-200PPM OF CHLORINE. ALL FOOD CONTACT SURFACES MUST BE SANITIZED IN SANITIZER VAT OF THREE-VAT SINK UNTIL DISHMACHINE IS SANITIZING PROPERLY. ENSURE CORRECTION BY FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: OBSERVED A CONSIDERABLE AMOUNT OF RAW LAMB BEING STORED IN TAKE-OUT PLASTIC BAGS IN 2-DOOR UPRIGHT FREEZER. OBSERVED RAW MEAT BEING STORED IN TAKE-OUT PLASTIC BAGS IN CHEST COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. REPLACE THESE BAGS WITH NSF APPROVED BAGS OR CONTAINERS. CEASE USING PLASTIC TAKE-OUT BAGS AS A FOOD CONTACT SURFACES. ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE DUMP SINK AT THE BAR TO BE NOT IN USE DUE TO LEAKING.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. REPAIR THIS SINK SO IT MAY BE UTILIZED. ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. Curry House (Inspection Date: 05/27/2025) Page 3 of 5

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Sewage Disposal System, Approved
violations.observation: Observed improper disposal of sewage (i.e. mop water, water used to clean refuse containers). WHEN ASKED WHERE THE MOP WATER IS DISPOSED OF, PIC STATED IT IS DUMPED OUTSIDE.
violations.corrective_action: Sewage shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an approved sanitary sewage system or other system including use of sewage transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to Law. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED. CEASE DUMPING MOP WATER OUTSIDE IMMEDIATELY. UTILIZE THE MOP SINK ONLY. ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Observed the improper type of ceiling panels in the dry storage closet.
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO REPLACE THE DRY STORAGE CLOSET CEILING PANELS WITH VINYL COATED (WASHABLE) CEILING PANELS WHEN THEY BECOME DAMAGED.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: fry chicken in the walk in cooler dated 11/16/24. Spinach in walk in cooler dated 11/16/24 was incorrectly dated.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. FRY CHICKEN WAS DISCARDED. SPINACH CORRECTLY DATED.
